source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 11ης Ιουνίου — «Άγιος Θεόπεμπτος, μαζί με άλλους τέσσερις μάρτυρες»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 11 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and carries no years. The corpus already keeps three other men of the name — `theopemptus-of-nicomedia` on 5 January, `theopemptus-2-january` and `theopemptus-7-february` — each on his own Greek day; on the settled rule, entries on separate days of one calendar are separate commemorations, so this is a fourth. The page gives him no place and no judge, and prints no hymn. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.
